CameraContext.setZoom(Object object)

Setting the Zoom Level(Minimum version: 23.9.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
zoom Number Yes Zoom level. The value ranges from 1 to maxZoom. Zoom is a positive integer. The value of maxZoom can be obtained from the return value of bindinitdone.
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function that ends the interface invoking. (This function is executed when the interface is successfully invoked or fails to be invoked.)

object.success callback function

Parameter

Object res
Attribute Type Description
zoom Number Actual zoom level. If the zoom value exceeds the maximum value supported by the system, the value closest to the target value is selected from [1, maxZoom].

Sample Code

function stopRecord(){
    const ctx = ma.createCameraContext();
    ctx.setZoom({
      zoom:zoom,
      success:(res)=>{
        console.log('success',res.zoom);
      },
      fail:(res)=>{
        console.log('fail');
      }
    })
  }
